source.request: Seed and settle the Octant epoch-12 multi-scalar market: 25 projects, each asking what share of total epoch funding (community contributions plus matching) that project receives.
source.proposalText: What will be the total % breakdown of total funding received by [project], both community contributions and matching, in octants epoch 12? [percent]
source.priceSourceNote: Seed prices from octant-initial-price.csv, column 'Rescaled', normalized as rescaled / sum(rescaled). The column sums to 100.00000000000001 across 25 rows, so a price is effectively rescaled/100. NOTE: the market was NOT created by this repo, so creation-side facts (market name as deployed, token naming, openingTime, lowerBound, category, lang) are not recorded anywhere here.

liquidity.unpooledByDesign: Nothing, ultimately. The main seed deliberately drops the Invalid outcome (25 pools), leaving the split's Invalid tokens idle; add-octant-invalid-liquidity.js then deploys those idle tokens into a 26th pool at a near-zero band [0.00001, 0.00005] for 0.0085 sUSDS. Sizing detail: equal outcome quantity Q across all 25 named pools, with Q solved linearly against the budget from one trial pass at Q0 = 1000e18. Realized Q = 8,759.78262055176, total exactly 20,000.000000 sUSDS.

settle.answerSource: resolution.xlsx, column B (Project) / column C (Actual Weight)
settle.answerScaleNote: THE trap this repo records. Octant is a [percent] question against upperBound 100e18, so 11.5923% is submitted as 11592300000000000000. L1's juror weights are a FRACTION of 1 against 1e18. Copying either scale to the other is 100x wrong — always read upperBound off the market. Encoding is parseUnits(weight.toFixed(4), 18); weights submitted summed to 99.9997%.

stages.name: phase1-seed
stages.notes: 25 pools, one per named project, blocks 153290819-153290983. Exactly 20,000.000000 sUSDS: split 8,759.78 + sUSDS side 11,240.22. Date from file mtime, corroborated by block numbers — this campaign kept no run logs.

stages.name: seed-invalid
stages.notes: A 26th pool for the Invalid outcome, block 153421820. Deploys the 8,759.78 idle Invalid tokens the split already produced for 0.0085 sUSDS — it never splits fresh collateral, and hard-fails if the balance is zero. Effectively free capital efficiency.

stages.name: unwind-withdraw
stages.notes: All 26 positions withdrawn at 100%, blocks 153568833-153568916. NFTs 1106305-1106329 plus 1107320.

stages.name: settle-answer
stages.notes: 25/25 answers submitted 08:49:11Z-08:52:00Z, blocks 154642085-154642169, 0.0005 ETH bond each (0.0125 ETH total). Seven spreadsheet-to-chain name mismatches needed a hardcoded ALIASES table. Questions would finalize ~2026-07-27.

stages.name: settle-resolve
stages.notes: No resolve script or artifact exists for octant in this repo. The campaign is described as resolved in prose only. There is also no redeem or merge script — and nothing to redeem, since all liquidity was withdrawn on 2026-06-29.

evidenceLog.learning: Two things worth carrying forward. First, the resolution bore almost no relation to the seed prices: Protocol Guild seeded 13.27% and resolved 3.91%; Tor seeded 5.41% and resolved 11.59%; Rotki 2.55% -> 9.93%. No LP loss followed only because the liquidity had already been withdrawn 25 days before the answers went in. Second, the answer unit is the single most dangerous field in this repo — a [percent] question against 100e18 here, a fraction against 1e18 on L1.

immutableText.note: The market was created outside this repo, so its deployed name, token symbols, openingTime, lowerBound, category and lang are not recorded here. addresses.arbitrator is likewise unknown for octant specifically — the sibling campaigns on the same factory use 0x5AFa42b30955f137e10f89dfb5EF1542a186F90e, but that is inference rather than evidence, so it is omitted.
